units.upward_air: relative dry column mass/s, positive upward

transport.scope: Actual simultaneous solved fields, all primer and scored steps; no transient storage equation

matched_native.definition: Pressure925–300hPa; per-step q*u, then Gregorian and same native footprint aggregation. Land variables use identical observed-rain land pixels with >=80% native area coverage; reference and modeled925hPa must be above ground. No fallback for empty masks.
limitations: Observed q*u is product of monthly reanalysis means, missing submonthly covariance.
Two-box model q and wind are piecewise constant in pressure; no resolved vertical momentum or energy.
WorldClim rain and NCEP climatology have different observational periods and construction.
These reused development regions and new Mexico fields are diagnostics, not independent held-out validation.

column_mass_balance.scope: Stationary equivalent-barotropic dry-column kinematic projection, open borders

two_layer_transport.humidity_profile: independently solved layer water; old fixed ratio inactive

moisture_reservoirs.rain_definition: Local dynamic gate and overflow; empirical convection uses whole-column humidity; shared lower-capacity RH evaporation routes upper precipitation into lower vapor
moisture_reservoirs.capacity_partition: normalized hydrostatic environmental profile; total capacity scheme separately declared
moisture_reservoirs.scope: Independent steady lower/upper water; no independent vertical energy/momentum
